0.0: #b#t1302014##k... A few decades ago, when I found out that Tristan had passed away, I couldn't believe my ears. I was the one that made the #b#t1302014##k for him. I thought anyone worthy of possessing that sword would have been indestructible. I heard that the sword has since gone bad... has it gone old and rusty?
0.1: So you want to reawaken this sword. It's not an easy task, though. You'll need to not only gather up hard-to-find materials, you'll also need a rare scroll for it. But if you still want to go along with it... then I want you to gather up the materials I'm about to tell you. I don't know if you can do it, but ...
0.2: Bring me 1 #b#t4003002##k, 1 #b#t4001005##k, and 1 #b#t4001006##k, along with that #b#t1302014##k you've got... I'm not sure how you should get these... #p1040001# in Sleepywood might know something...

yes.0: I will be waiting for you here.

no.0: Don't you think that's a small price to pay to awaken the Hero's Gladius? But if you can't handle it, I suppose you can quit now.

1.0: My goodness! You did collect #b1 #t4021009##k, #b1 #t4003002##k, #b1 #t4001005##k, and #b1 #t4001006##k! Alright, then. Hold on one second. I haven't done this in ages, but... with these materials, I may be able to pull off the magic and reawaken the #b#t1302014##k.

yes.0: Incredible... Tristan's sword... I didn't think I'd live to see this again. I don't know who left you with this, but please tell that person that this sword is meant to be used the right way. My work is done. So long ...

item.0: I may have gone old and gray, but my eyes cannot be deceived. Please gather up #b1 #t4021009##k, #b1 #t4003002##k, #b1 #t4001005##k, and #b1 #t4001006##k, because I don't think you have them all yet.

QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Reawakening the Gladius
QuestInfo.1: You showed Chrishrama Manji's #bOld Gladius#k, and he claimed to have made it himself. He said that he needs #b1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flamed Feather#k to awaken it. Unfortunately, you've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to #rMike in Sleepywood#k to find them.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the materials needed for the awakening and took them to Chrishrama. Chrishrama used the materials to awaken Old Gladius of the #bHero's Gladius#k. It's a nice sword radiating a mysterious light... It's a shame to give it to Chun Ji.
QuestInfo.summary: I need to find the materials needed to reawaken the Gladius and take it to Chrishrama.
QuestInfo.0: See Chrishrama in Sleepywood to awaken the #bOld Gladius#k.
